items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Old Tommy looked at Pandssie and say... Pandssie was still looking sad and Tommy said... And Pandssie kind of smiled a little

ctx.x: And they were out of practice eh?

Yes. So that's where that Viva La France came from. (LAUGHTER). Old Tommy looked at Pandssie and say, and he had on a cap and it was cold, he said, 'Viva La France. Because he know that would get that Frenchman's see? So, Pandssie was still looking sad and Tommy said, 'Viva La France I say.' And Pandssie kind of smiled a little and Tommy said, well alright then God damn it.
This is after he and James P. had got drunk was it?
